description: YouTube research without a Google account or API key. Search videos, channels and hashtags, see trending Shorts, read any channel's stats, videos, Shorts, playlists and community posts, and pull a video's details, comments and replies. Use this skill for content research, competitor channel analysis, finding video ideas, or tracking what performs on YouTube.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
